papers.title: Neural Network-Based Active Learning in Multivariate Calibration
papers.abstract: In chemometrics, data from infrared or near-infrared (NIR) spectroscopy are often used to identify a compound or to analyze the composition of amaterial. This involves the calibration of models that predict the concentration ofmaterial constituents from the measured NIR spectrum. An interesting aspect of multivariate calibration is to achieve a particular accuracy level with a minimum number of training samples, as this reduces the number of laboratory tests and thus the cost of model building. In these chemometric models, the input refers to a proper representation of the spectra and the output to the concentrations of the sample constituents. The search for a most informative new calibration sample thus has to be performed in the output space of the model, rather than in the input space as in conventionalmodeling problems. In this paper, we propose to solve the corresponding inversion problem by utilizing the disagreements of an ensemble of neural networks to represent the prediction error in the unexplored component space. The next calibration sample is then chosen at a composition where the individual models of the ensemble disagree most. The results obtained for a realistic chemometric calibration example show that the proposed active learning can achieve a given calibration accuracy with less training samples than random sampling.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出基于神经网络集成不确定性的主动学习方法，虽用于化学计量学，但可迁移至代理建模中的高效采样策略。
llm.why_not_core: No application to finite element analysis, implant biomechanics, or any solid-mechanics surrogate modeling; constrained optimization not addressed.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少化学计量学中校准模型所需的训练样本数量以降低成本。
summary_zh.method: 利用神经网络集成的不一致性选择最有信息的校准样本。
summary_zh.result: 主动学习比随机采样用更少的样本达到相同精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在真实化学计量校准例上验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To minimize the number of training samples required for accurate calibration in multivariate chemometric models.
summary_en.method: An active learning approach that selects the next calibration sample where an ensemble of neural networks shows the highest disagreement.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves target calibration accuracy with fewer training samples than random sampling.
summary_en.validation: Tested on a realistic chemometric calibration example demonstrating the efficiency gain.

papers.title: The effect of femoral neck osteotomy on femoral component position of a primary cementless total hip arthroplasty

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文主要研究股骨颈截骨对假体位置的影响，属于手术技术范畴，未涉及股骨柄的应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: Does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics for femoral stem.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨股骨颈截骨对无骨水泥全髋置换术中假体位置的影响
summary_zh.method: 临床研究，分析不同截骨方式下的假体位置
summary_zh.result: 截骨方式影响假体最终位置

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates how the level and orientation of femoral neck osteotomy affect final component position in cementless total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A clinical retrospective analysis of postoperative radiographs comparing different osteotomy techniques.
summary_en.result: Femoral neck osteotomy parameters significantly influence the final position of the femoral component.
summary_en.validation: Clinical radiographic assessment without biomechanical testing or finite element analysis.
